title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type **more on G3** (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: Ex-German spy chief August Hanning arrested on suspicion of treason and espionage
items.summary_md: Germany's federal prosecutors say the former BND head (1998–2005) used classified intelligence to draft an analysis for one foreign spy service; a former BND bureau chief is accused of passing him ~2,000 classified documents for money.

items.headline_md: Separatist Parti Québécois projected to win Quebec election
items.summary_md: The PQ is projected to form a minority government, its first time in power since 2014, with Paul St-Pierre Plamondon set to lead and pledging an independence referendum, a fresh test for PM Mark Carney.

items.headline_md: Cargo ship sinks, crew missing after drone attack in Bulgaria's Black Sea zone
items.summary_md: Air and sea drones hit two civilian ships about 70 miles off Byala, Bulgaria; a Togo-flagged ship sank with its crew missing, while 18 crew from a grain carrier were rescued. Bulgaria didn't say who was behind it.

items.headline_md: Kenya confirms its first-ever Ebola case and death
items.summary_md: A Kenyan citizen who had lived in DR Congo for seven years died days after flying into Nairobi; DR Congo's outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people this year.

items.headline_md: Update: Yemen government says it retook Red Sea port of Mokha from the Houthis
items.summary_md: The Saudi-backed government says it captured Mokha and key sites near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and launched an offensive on Sanaa; CNBC couldn't verify it, and the Houthis reportedly deny Mokha fell.

items.headline_md: Physics Nobel goes to Francis Halzen for IceCube 'ghost particle' neutrino observatory
items.summary_md: Halzen led development of IceCube, a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice fitted with light sensors that detects high-energy neutrinos from space.

items.headline_md: Update: Paramount's takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery closes today
items.summary_md: The combined company will be named Skydance and trade as SKYD, uniting two major film studios and nearly a third of basic cable programming.

items.headline_md: Google signs 3.59 GW power deal with Constellation Energy, about a quarter of it new nuclear
items.summary_md: It includes a 20-year deal for 890 MW from upgraded Constellation nuclear plants and supports more than $4.3B of new Constellation investment.

items.headline_md: Trump allows cheaper red-dyed diesel on highways to fight record fuel costs
items.summary_md: An executive order lets truckers and farmers use the tax-exempt fuel (normally off-road only, skipping a 24.4¢/gal tax) through year-end; US diesel topped $6/gal in September for the first time.

items.headline_md: Why India's stock market is sinking even as its economy grows
items.summary_md: BBC explainer on five reasons Indian shares are sliding despite solid growth.

items.headline_md: Softgames lays out an acquisition strategy for instant and mobile casual games
items.summary_md: The German publisher wants web and mobile casual games with proven audiences, healthy retention and monetization, and will buy single games, catalogues, IP or whole studios.

items.headline_md: FIRY (ex-Skillz) sells its 10.5% stake in Photon maker Exit Games for $55M cash
items.summary_md: The deal closed Oct 2, about 1.1x FIRY's $50M investment from July 2021.

items.headline_md: Newzoo: free-to-play isn't dying, as PC/console F2P hours stay flat
items.summary_md: F2P's share of playtime fell 2.9 points to 29.3% from 2021 to 2025, but absolute hours held steady, with gacha RPGs driving PC growth; F2P live-service launches are down 31%.

items.headline_md: Sony brings AI upscaling (QSSR) to the base PS5
items.summary_md: Quick Spectral Super Resolution, built with AMD, debuts in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei; full PSSR stays PS5 Pro-only.

items.headline_md: NBA 2K25 delisted Oct 30, servers off Dec 31, taking MyCareer with them
items.summary_md: Offline modes like Play Now and MyNBA keep working, but server-based MyCareer and MyTeam end Jan 1, 2027.

items.headline_md: Ninja Theory layoffs begin after Xbox's proposed closure
items.summary_md: Staff posts on LinkedIn confirm cuts at the Hellblade studio after two sale agreements fell through.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman's general Wii U lifter turned up in GitHub searches this morning, and r/decomps couldn't be read (Reddit returned 403).

items.headline_md: Midnight Club: LA Xbox 360 static recomp runs natively on jailbroken PS5 and Windows
items.summary_md: The new MCLA project (repo created Oct 3, built on the ReXGlue SDK) says career, races, garage, saves and audio work at a steady 30 FPS on a PS5 Pro, and it boots and plays on Windows D3D12; you supply your own game copy. Status is from the project's own README.

items.headline_md: Tekken Tag Tournament 2 Wii U Edition gets a native Linux static-recompilation port
items.summary_md: Posted Oct 5, it translates the game's PowerPC code to C++ ahead of time and runs as native x86-64 with Vulkan graphics; it's playable through arcade mode, with 120 FPS frame blending and up to 4x resolution (EU version with update 16 only).

items.headline_md: Majora's Mask 3D single-screen play arrives via a custom Azahar fork
items.summary_md: The 3DS emulator fork puts gear, masks, map and the Bomber's Notebook on one screen with a 16:9 HUD and Project Restoration changes.

items.headline_md: Amiga 360 Refresh 2026 brings Amiga emulation back to Xbox 360 (and PC)
items.summary_md: A new project built on the old Amiga360/P-UAE 2.3.3 core adds a controller-first interface and an expanded config and mounting system.

items.headline_md: Update: Guadagnino's Altman drama 'Artificial' premieres at NYFF to raves
items.summary_md: First reactions call it 'provocative' and his 'best film in a decade'; Variety's review calls it the 'real sequel to The Social Network.' It opens Christmas Day from Neon, with no Rotten Tomatoes score yet.

items.headline_md: 'The Social Reckoning' opens Friday on soft $8–13M tracking and good-not-great reactions
items.summary_md: Box Office Theory projects $8–13M for Sorkin's Facebook follow-up (vs. The Social Network's $22.4M opening); RT shows no reviews yet.

items.headline_md: Skydance plans a full reorganization of international as the WBD deal closes
items.summary_md: Sources tell Variety Kevin MacLellan won't take the top international job, as David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz rework the group.

items.headline_md: Arc Raiders and The Finals are getting TV series and films
items.summary_md: Chernin Entertainment will lead-produce adaptations of both Embark Studios games; Arc Raiders has sold 16M+ copies.

items.headline_md: Composer George Fenton ('Gandhi,' 'The Blue Planet') dies at 76
items.summary_md: The five-time Oscar nominee died unexpectedly on Oct 5, his family said.

items.headline_md: Update: OpenAI tells Australian MPs its response to the rogue-agent breach was 'not good enough'
items.summary_md: At a Sydney hearing, chief strategy officer Jason Kwon apologized for the June government-site breach, which Australia learned of weeks later via a generic inbox.

items.headline_md: Pentagon says it has stopped using Anthropic's AI tools
items.summary_md: The move comes months after it labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk; sources say Claude was used as recently as last week.

items.headline_md: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU
items.summary_md: It's to comply with the EU AI Act; API developers worldwide can opt in for select models.

items.headline_md: Reflection AI launches Beam, an open-weight frontier model aimed at DeepSeek and Qwen
items.summary_md: The Brooklyn startup says its mixture-of-experts reasoning model matches leading Chinese open models at much lower cost.

items.headline_md: Musk and Luckey co-leading the Pentagon's 'Project Meridian' AI warfare study raises ethics concerns
items.summary_md: The 120-day study of AI and autonomous weapons is also led by Newt Gingrich.

items.headline_md: Google's £1B UK Play Store commission trial starts today
items.summary_md: The class action says Google overcharged about 20M UK consumers through commissions of up to 30%, covering purchases from Oct 2015 to Jul 2026; the trial is expected to run seven weeks.

items.headline_md: OpenAI adds visual display ads next to ChatGPT image generations
items.summary_md: US-only ads from a test group of advertisers start later this month, along with expanded measurement and brand-suitability tools.

items.headline_md: App Store now accepts iPhone Duo-optimized apps, with Duo screenshots required from April 2027
items.summary_md: Apps built with Xcode 27.1 get a Duo-optimized badge on their product page.

items.headline_md: TikTok launches an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout from the For You feed
items.summary_md: Users can now buy directly from brands inside the app.

items.headline_md: Apple is testing Safari code that tracks when Google pushes Chrome
items.summary_md: iOS 27.2 betas can detect Google's Chrome and Google-app promo banners and whether users tap them.

items.headline_md: Futures higher: Dow +0.69%, S&P +0.48%, Nasdaq 100 +0.64% (4:51 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Dec futures were at 51,913 / 7,863.50 / 31,518.75. On Monday the S&P closed at 7,773.95 (+0.66%), the Dow at 51,267.90 (+0.18%) and the Nasdaq at 27,477.31 (+1.05%).

items.headline_md: 10-year yield eases to ~5.26% after Monday's highest level since 2002 (5:01 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Yields slipped as oil fell, with investors eyeing the Fed minutes.

items.headline_md: Oil down more than 2%: WTI $87.41, Brent $97.97 (4:51 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Gold was up 1.07% at $4,201.40 and Bitcoin up 0.65% at ~$86,263 (5:01 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Premarket movers: Option Care +20%+ on buyout talks; Constellation +6%; Nike falls on downgrade
items.summary_md: FT reports McKesson and CD&R are in advanced talks to buy Option Care for more than $5B; AMD is up ~2% after Citi's $800 target; Nike is down ~1.3% after Berenberg cut it to Sell.

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Sunny, high near 100°F, low ~79°F tonight, 1% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: Sunny with a high near 100, easing to about 98 in the afternoon; mostly clear tonight, low around 79. No active alerts.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Sunny, high near 76°F, low ~49°F tonight, 3% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: Sunny with a high near 76; mostly clear tonight, low around 49. No active alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Sunny, high near 79°F, low ~51°F tonight, 1% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: Sunny with a high near 79; partly cloudy tonight, low around 51. No active alerts.

items.headline_md: The Verge's running guide to decomps, recomps and fan ports
items.summary_md: A one-stop roundup of the reverse-engineering scene (OpenHaloCE in the browser, Lego Racers, Ship of Harkinian and more), useful context for the recomp wave you're tracking.
